entries.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: production Unity 2D pixel art animation sprite sheet. Edit target/reference: existing green slime monster idle strip; preserve this monster's simple faceless emerald slime identity, dark navy outline and chunky pixel art. Rebuild as ONE clean transparent sprite sheet containing EXACTLY 4 COLUMNS x 5 ROWS = 20 sprites. Canvas 1024 wide x 1280 tall, identical 256x256 cells, no margins between cells. Each sprite within its cell with plenty of transparent padding. All frames use identical camera, pixel scale and body mass. Right-facing side view. Body in neutral pose about 140px wide, 100px tall; fixed horizontal anchor x=128 per cell and ground at y=224 per cell. Row1 Idle: subtle breathing 4 poses returning toward start. Row2 Walk: four coherent squash-stretch locomotion poses. Row3 Attack: anticipation, forward lean, forward lunge, recovery. Row4 Dead: stagger, collapse, flatten, motionless puddle retaining green material. Row5 Hurt: neutral impact, recoil, settle, recover. Deliberate pose changes only; no random scaling or centering across frames. True transparent alpha background, clean silhouette, solid colored sprite interiors (no accidental holes). Remove all original gray/purple background contamination, cast shadows and colored fringe. No purple tint. No text, labels, borders, grid, floor, effects or extra objects. Keep consistent same monster throughout all 20 cells. Output PNG.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Production Unity 2D pixel-art animation sprite sheet. Input is edit target and character identity reference. Rebuild the same creature with consistent anatomy, palette, silhouette and chunky 16-bit pixels, dark outline. ONE transparent PNG with EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS and FIVE ROWS, 20 separate complete sprites. Equal square cells in a regular grid filling canvas; no labels or grid lines. Every sprite faces RIGHT consistently. Within each cell keep torso scale and horizontal origin constant, fixed ground baseline at 85% cell height. Keep ample transparent padding and never overlap cells. Neutral creature occupies about 55% cell width and 50% cell height, leave room for lunges. Row1 IDLE: four subtle breathing poses. Row2 WALK: four distinct alternating leg or wing cycle poses. Row3 ATTACK: anticipation, windup, rightward strike, recovery. Row4 DEAD: stagger, knees buckle, collapse, visibly lying defeated on ground in last cell. Row5 HURT: impact, backward recoil, settle, recover. All 5 rows depict SAME creature at identical scale and detail. No random zoom, no floating feet for grounded creatures, no accidental holes. True transparent alpha background. Remove background, original drop shadows and magenta/purple contamination; no scenery, ground line, glow, attack effects, text or borders. Preserve intentional creature palette. Forest spider: olive-green abdomen, brown chitin legs, red eyes, eight legs. Four walk poses must alternate legs; dead end has folded legs and body resting on floor. Reference faces left; correct ALL output poses to face right.
